plan.concept: Idealized 1D frequency response profiles of basic filter types: Low-pass, Band-pass, and High-pass.
plan.layout: 1x3 horizontal grid of three separate 1D coordinate systems representing frequency responses
plan.colorScheme: Monochrome: Black lines and text (#000000) on a clean white background (#ffffff).
plan.reconstructionNotes: Ensure the axes have arrowheads at the positive ends. The filter curves themselves are styled with a significantly thicker stroke than the axes to make them stand out. Italicized math symbols should be used for the 'u' and '|H(u)|' labels.
